description: Required markers on array-of-object entry fields declared inside a reusable type are enforced per present element, for both the reference form (arr[] = @type) and the inline form (arr[].field). Absent arrays are skipped (permissive); present-but-incomplete entries fail with V001 at the indexed path.

tests.description: arr[] = @type: a present entry missing a required entry field fails with V001 at the indexed path
tests.schema:
{$}
odin = "1.0.0"
schema = "1.0.0"
id = "array-required-ref"
version = "1.0.0"

{@uw_producer}
carrier_id = !
code = !

{@uw_agency}
id = !
name =
producers[] = @uw_producer

{}
agency = @uw_agency
